gloss: hey!; come now!; what with … and …

definitions.explanation: An old-fashioned call that urges, scolds or stops someone, or voices mild surprise or relief. Today it survives mainly in older writing, set phrases, and the doubled form やれやれ.
Repeated before each item (やれ X だ、やれ Y だ) to list one thing after another, usually demands, complaints or chores, with a tone of exasperation.

examples.english: Don't swat it! The fly is wringing its hands and feet. (haiku by Kobayashi Issa)

examples.japanese: やれ、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ひと⟦{安心|あんしん}→安心：01288_anshin⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧つぶやいた。
examples.english: "Well, that's a relief," my father murmured.

examples.japanese: やれ⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧だ、やれ⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: What with homework and cram school, I'm busy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧やれ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦しろ→する：00392_suru⟧、やれ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}しろ→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦うるさい→うるさい：00763_urusai⟧。
examples.english: My mother nags me constantly: clean up, study.

examples.japanese: やれ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧だ、やれ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: What with meetings and business trips, I had no time at home this month.

notes:
Sense 1 is best known from the haiku by ⟦{小林一茶|こばやしいっさ}→小林一茶：31981_kobayashiissa⟧ in the examples.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- やれやれ: well, well; phew (relief or weary resignation)
- やれ X だ、やれ Y だ: what with X and Y
- やれ X ⟦しろ→する：00392_suru⟧、やれ Y しろ: do X, do Y (a string of orders)

USAGE:
Sense 2 nearly always lists two or more items and carries a note of complaint; it is common in everyday speech and writing. Sense 1 alone sounds dated.
